transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Most nights after my wife goes to bed, I end up in the kitchen eating way more than a normal meal. Fried chicken, mac and cheese, sweet potatoes, rolls—whatever leftovers are there. I keep going until a whole tray, or half the fridge, is gone.
After eating like this, do you ever do anything to try to make up for the food you ate, such as making yourself throw up?
No, I don’t make myself throw up or anything like that.
During these eating episodes, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating?
Yeah. Once I take that first bite, it’s like I’ve already decided, even if I’m telling myself, “George, stop.” I just keep making another plate or opening something else.
Do these eating episodes happen after you have already fallen asleep, or are you still awake before going to bed?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid attention to whether I’m asleep first or not.
Do you ever find yourself eating like this during the daytime, or does it only happen late at night?
I’m honestly not sure. I haven’t really kept track of the time of day when it happens.
How do you feel emotionally after one of these eating episodes?

Afterward, I feel sick with myself. I’m ashamed and guilty, disgusted that I let it happen again. People see me as organized and strong, but then I’m sitting there feeling like I’ve completely failed.
How long have you been having these episodes of overeating?
I guess it started when the foreclosure process began—so, about a year and two months ago.
During these episodes, do you keep eating until you feel uncomfortably full?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really paid attention to whether I get to that point.
Do you find yourself eating these large amounts of food even when you don't feel physically hungry?
Yes, a lot of the time I’m not hungry at all. I might have eaten dinner with my wife, and then later I’ll start picking at leftovers, and it just turns into another whole spread of food.
During these episodes, do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than normal?

Yeah. I eat really fast when it happens—sometimes I’m standing at the counter taking big bites and swallowing before I’ve even finished chewing the last one. I barely taste the food, even stuff I used to take pride in cooking.
